model.name: DeviceEnrollDialog.removeLocalIdentity
model.description: ProfileEditor.ts: red button below secret-code field. onClick: show danger modal with warning text + confirm input (type DELETE or re-enter 4-digit secret). On confirm: for each of 12 rawbin-* keys: localStorage.removeItem(key). Then ws.close(), location.reload(). New session generates fresh playerToken+deviceId UUIDs → profile gate (uncommitted).
